fields.Name: IT178 - Open App Install From a Local Folder
fields.Description: Live proof of installing an Open App from a folder in the consumer repository (a file: locator), deterministic (no model calls, no network). The bundle builds a throwaway pnpm workspace in the OS temp directory and drives the real InstallApp / UpgradeApp / RemoveApp. OLS1-OLS5 (one app, in order): install records the file: locator and runs migrations kept in subfolders from the directory for the live platform; upgrade to a new folder version runs only the new migration; an upgrade at the folder version does nothing and Reapply runs it again; remove while the folder is at another version changes nothing; remove drops the schema. OLS6-OLS10: a requested version the folder does not have and an app package outside the workspace both stop before any change; app packages are written as workspace:* and linked by pnpm; a file: dependency installs from its folder first; a folder outside the repository is refused. OLS1-OLS5 and OLS9 need a login that can create and drop schemas. The bundle removes every app, schema, row and folder it creates.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Local installs record a file: locator, run the folder's migrations, honor the folder version on upgrade and remove, write workspace:* package versions, install file: dependencies, and refuse bad input before any change.
